how_to_apply: This recruitment does not have an online application process. Applications must be submitted only by post, in the prescribed proforma given in the notification.
Download or note the application proforma (Appendix format) provided at the end of the official notification.
Fill the application on plain paper, either typed or neatly handwritten, in English or Hindi.
Paste one recent passport-size photograph (self-attested) on the form, and enclose two additional self-attested photographs separately (mobile printouts/selfies are not accepted).
Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates and documents listed in the Documents section above.
Enclose one self-addressed envelope duly affixed with the appropriate postal stamp.

On the application cover envelope, write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ____" in capital letters, along with the overall percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation/equivalent, written in the specified colour ink: Red ink for 50% or below, Blue ink for 51% to 60%, and Black ink for 61% and above.
Send the completed application by post to: The Presiding Officer, Civilian Direct Recruitment Board, Civ CR, ASC Centre (South), Agram Post, Bangalore – 560007.

Candidates should apply for only one trade; applications from candidates found applying for more than one trade will be rejected. All correspondence, including despatch of call letters for the written test, will be through e-mail only; the physical copy of the call letter will be sent separately by post. Candidates must therefore ensure their functional mobile number and e-mail address are mentioned in the application.
important_instructions: Physically handicapped (PWD) candidates have no reserved vacancies in the following trades: CCI, Cook, MTS (Chowkidar), Cleaner, Labour, and Civil Motor Driver. Aadhaar Card prepared below 10 years of age will not be accepted; Aadhaar and PAN must bear the applicant’s name exactly as per the School Certificate. OBC, SC, ST, and EWS category candidates must submit legitimate certificates issued by the competent authority as prescribed under DoPT O.M. No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31-01-2019. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/ESM/PWD/MSP candidates have the right to compete for General/unreserved vacancies; in such cases, no concession or relaxation applicable to their category will be provided. OBC candidates must submit an additional undertaking (Non-Creamy Layer declaration) in the format given in the notification (Appendix-IV). Ex-servicemen (ESM) candidates must submit an Ex-servicemen certificate along with a self-attested copy of the Discharge Certificate and an Undertaking in the format given in the notification (Appendix-III). Serving Defence personnel (Army/Navy/Air Force) and Defence Civilian Employees currently in service must enclose a "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) issued by their Record Office. Persons already employed in Central/State Government or a PSU must apply through proper channel, along with a certificate from their establishment confirming no disciplinary action is pending and no objection to their release if selected. Meeting the basic eligibility criteria does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for the Skill/Physical/Practical and written test; shortlisting may be resorted to if the number of applications is large. All selected candidates are liable for All India service and may be posted to Hard Areas, High Altitude Areas, Remote Locality Areas, or Field Areas. Selected candidates are advised to give a choice of three stations in order of preference; final posting will be subject to administrative requirements. There is no provision for re-evaluation or re-checking of scores; no correspondence in this regard will be entertained. The number of vacancies mentioned in the notification is provisional and can be changed by the Commandant, ASC Centre (South), if necessary. The recruitment process can also be cancelled, suspended, or terminated at any stage for administrative reasons. Candidates are cautioned against unscrupulous elements offering assurance of appointment through illegal gratification; selection is made purely on merit through a transparent process.

content_sections.heading: ASC Centre (South) Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: ASC Centre (South) has advertised 62 posts in total across nine trades. Vacancies are tentative and the Commandant, ASC Centre (South) reserves the right to change the number if necessary. Candidates can apply for only one trade. All posts advertised in this notice are open to male candidates only, as specified in the official notification. Horizontal reservation is applicable as per the notification: 4% reserve for Persons with Disability (PWD), 10% reserve for Ex-servicemen (ESM), and 5% reserve for Meritorious Sports Persons (MSP), at the discretion of the Appointing Authority. The notification also provides a tentative station-wise breakup of vacancies. Candidates give a preference of three stations in their application; final posting is at the discretion of the Commandant, ASC Centre (South). Note on data accuracy: For Leading Fireman, the notification states the station-wise total as 14, but the individual station figures listed above (Kandrori, Missamari, Bareilly, Ferozpur, Jalandhar, Rajouri, Pathankot, Suratgarh, Bhatinda) add up to 13. This discrepancy exists in the original notification and has been reproduced here without alteration; candidates should verify the exact figure from the official notice or contact ASC Centre (South) directly.

content_sections.heading: ASC Centre (South) Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements vary by post. All posts require Matriculation (Class 10) or equivalent as the base qualification, with additional trade-specific requirements as listed below. Certain posts require candidates to clear physical fitness and endurance standards before appearing for the written test.

rows.qualification_experience_required: Matriculation or equivalent; Diploma/Certificate in catering from a recognised institution; one year of experience in catering as an instructor is desirable.
Matriculation or equivalent; knowledge of Indian cooking and proficiency in the trade; one year of trade experience is desirable.
Matriculation or equivalent; should be proficient in trade work.
Matriculation or equivalent; must possess a valid driving licence for both heavy and light motor vehicles; should have at least two years of driving experience.
Matriculation or equivalent; should be proficient in trade work.
Matriculation or equivalent; should be proficient in trade.

Matriculation or equivalent; should be proficient in trade work; at least three years’ experience driving heavy vehicles and a valid driving licence; preferably certified after attending a fireman course.

Matriculation or equivalent; must be conversant with the use and maintenance of extinguishers, hose fittings, fire engines, trailers, pumps and foam branches; familiar with first-aid fire fighting appliances and trailer fire pump; must know elementary fire fighting principles and be able to perform assigned fire crew duties.

Matriculation or equivalent; must be conversant with the use and maintenance of all types of extinguishers, hose fittings and fire equipment; must be capable of training, guiding and controlling the working of the B crane, and capable of taking independent charge of a shift.

rows.physical_endurance_requirement: 1.5 km run in 6 minutes and carrying a 50 kg weight to a distance of 200 metres in 100 seconds. Relaxed timings apply for Ex-servicemen by age band (below 40, 40–45, and above 45 years) as specified in the notification.

rows.post: Fire Engine Driver, Fireman & Leading Fireman
rows.physical_endurance_requirement: Height without shoes: 165 cm (2.5 cm concession for ST candidates); Chest un-expanded: 81.5 cm; Chest expanded: 85 cm; Weight: 50 kg minimum. Endurance/Skill Test: carrying a man (fireman lift of 65.5 kg) a distance of 183 metres within 96 seconds; clearing a 2.7-metre-wide ditch landing on both feet (long jump); and climbing a 3-metre vertical rope using hands and feet.

faq.question: Q1. What is ASC Centre (South) Bangalore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an Employment Notice issued by ASC Centre (South), under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, inviting applications for 62 civilian posts across nine trades: CCI, Cook, MTS (Chowkidar), Civilian Motor Driver, Cleaner, Tradesman Mate (Labour), Fire Engine Driver, Fireman, and Leading Fireman.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ASC Centre (South) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 62 vacancies are available across all nine posts, though this number is tentative and subject to change as per the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ASC Centre (South) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar. The exact calendar date is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for ASC Centre (South) posts?
faq.answer: Matriculation or equivalent is the minimum qualification for all posts, with additional trade-specific requirements (such as a diploma in catering, a valid driving licence, or trade proficiency) depending on the post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ASC Centre (South) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 25 years for most posts and 18 to 27 years for Civilian Motor Driver, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories, Ex-servicemen, and PWD candidates as per Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for ASC Centre (South) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by post, in the prescribed proforma, along with self-attested documents and a self-addressed registered envelope, sent to the Presiding Officer, Civilian Direct Recruitment Board, ASC Centre (South), Agram Post, Bangalore – 560007. There is no online application mode for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ASC Centre (South) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must first qualify a Skill/Physical/Practical test (as applicable to the post), after which they become eligible to appear for a written test. Final selection is made purely on the basis of marks obtained in the written test.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for ASC Centre (South) posts?
faq.answer: Starting basic pay ranges from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 21,700 depending on the Pay Matrix Level of the post, plus Dearness Allowance (DA) and other allowances as admissible.
